policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Section 2 - Purpose
(1)
This Procedure establishes a process for the selection and appointment of the Associate Dean and Deputy Dean positions at La Trobe University.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Section 3 - Scope
(2)
This Procedure applies to Academic staff in a continuing or fixed-term position at the University.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Section 4 - Key Decisions
Key Decisions
Role
Determine Level B staff members eligible to apply for an Associate Dean or Deputy Dean appointment.
Provost
Approve the appointment of an Associate Dean or Deputy Dean.
Provost

Provost

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Section 5 - Policy Statement
(3)
This procedure forms part of the
Recruitment Policy
suite which governs its application.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Internal Appointments
(4)
Generally, the Associate Dean and Deputy Dean position is open only to internal applicants.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Responsibility
(5)
The Dean is responsible for the appointment process of Associate Dean and Deputy Dean within their school. The Dean may call for expressions of interest or offer a subsequent contract to the incumbent of the Associate Dean or Deputy Dean position.
(6)
The Provost has final authority to approve the appointment of the Associate Dean or Deputy Dean position.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Eligibility
(7)
Staff members at Level C or above may be eligible to express an interest in the position of Associate Dean and Deputy Dean.
(8)
However, on recommendation of the Dean, the Provost may determine that staff members at Level B are eligible to express an interest.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Terms of Appointment
(9)
The Associate Dean and Deputy Dean appointment will combine a substantive academic appointment with a fixed-term secondment to Associate Dean or Deputy Dean (up to a maximum of five (5) years).

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Advertising a Position
(10)
To advertise the Associate Dean and Deputy Dean position internally, a Job Card must be raised through Page Up via an Expression of Interest process. For more information contact Talent Acquisition.
(11)
The Dean will inform staff members of the opportunity.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Application
(12)
To apply for the position, internal candidates are required to:
submit an expression of interest through Page Up; and
address any requirements that are specified as part of the application process for that position.
(13)
Selection Process
(14)
The Associate Dean and Deputy Dean Selection Committee will make a selection based on merit.
(15)
For internal applicants the Associate Dean and Deputy Dean Selection Committee will comprise:
Dean (Chair) or delegate; and
Provost or delegate
Appropriate Pro Vice-Chancellor or delegate
Head of Department or equivalent or relevant delegate

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Assessment of Suitable Candidates
(16)
The Associate Dean and Deputy Dean Selection Committee will review submitted applications conduct interviews, and other suitable assessments such as requesting a presentation be provided etc. for suitability against the requirements of the position based on merit.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Finalising an Appointment
(17)
The Chair will make the verbal offer to the successful candidate and, upon verbal acceptance from the candidate, will submit the Post Interview Matrix Form to the TA team with the outcome to generate the offer card in PageUp.
(18)
A contract will be sent to the successful candidate for acceptance electronically.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Internal Appointments
(19)
All internal appointments to an Associate Dean or Deputy Dean position will be on a secondment arrangement.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
External Appointments
(20)
In exceptional circumstances and on the recommendation of the Dean, the Provost may approve the decision to externally recruit a senior academic.
(21)
External appointments will combine a substantive academic position with a fixed term secondment Associate and Deputy Dean position, for (up to a maximum of five (5) years).
(22)
To initiate an external recruitment process, contact Talent Acquisition.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Termination of Appointment
(23)
The Associate Dean and Deputy Dean secondment will end at the date outlined in the contract of employment, unless terminated earlier.
(24)
The Dean in consultation with the Chief People Officer may recommend the early termination of the Associate Dean and Deputy Dean secondment to the Provost.
(25)
The Provost has final authority to approve the early termination of Associate Dean and Deputy Dean secondment. The incumbent will then revert to their substantive academic position.

policy_title: Recruitment Procedure - Associate Dean and Deputy Dean
text:
Section 7 - Definitions
(26)
For the purpose of this Procedure:
Job Card: is the process in Page Up where hiring managers provide details of a position and recruitment requirements.
PageUp: is the University’s e-recruitment system
